label: PhotovoltaicModule
definition: A photovoltaic module is a collection of solar cell circuits sealed in an environmentally protective laminate. Packaging of modules typically includes layering cells between materials such as glass for the front and back, a top and rear encapsulation layer, cells and interconnects, passivation layers and optical coatings, all enclosed in a metal frame. Performance of PV modules are generally rated according to their electrical outputs under standard test conditions. Modules are used in the field together as arrays that make up a power generation site.
